newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shopping complex hit by fire.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shopping complex hit by fire.

text.p: Fire burned out more than 100 shops including a big Matahari department store in a four-storey complex in central Jakarta on Monday, police said.
Eyewitnesses said flames were spreading to a second building in the Pasar Baru area, but police said there were no reports of casualties.
"The Matahari store appears to be badly damaged. The complex is still ablaze," an eyewitness told Reuters.
Police said the fire apparently broke out on the second floor of the complex around 5:30 a.m. Many of the shops dealt in electrical and technical equipment.
A Matahari outlet was damaged by fire during riots in the west Java town of Tasikmalaya in late December.
